author: dev_revs
body:
Hey guys, as all of you know the only gamemode that is real ever played is nebula, some times you will catch some people on capture the wool, walls is getting more popular by the week, but other than that, no one plays survival games,control the hill, tdm or anything.

Let's get to the point

Free for all

Objective is to get the most kills before the game ends. You may say like "that is basically tdm" but not really, you are playing this by yourself and if you decide to team, you can be reported for staff to deal with.

Maps. 

IN MY OPINION the maps for this gamemode should be player made maps of remakes from other games. If you look on my brothers youtube channel (Thechosenguy1) Him and I have made two maps from Call of duty Modern warfare 3. I feel like maps like these would give players more of a feel of that game and would force them to hop on and test it out. I also see there is a TDM map based off a csgo game. Perfect! You have one map, and if you are interested in my brothers and I's we can work that out later. I would not recommend downloading the maps from online because that is trash, those are good maps, but no fun in it. ON THE SECOND HAND, maybe maps like these should be added to the regular TDM rotation

Players, how it works

I would say it would be played in a 10 player lobby where those players will fight for the most kills and least deaths. In order for this to be succesful, a score box on the side of your screen with every player in the lobby's name on it  and KD for that game.

Tournaments

Having this gamemode would also be a HUGE  addition for tourneys to be hosted and be a fun game to compete in. 

If you have any other suggestions or feedback, please leave it in the comments. I really hope this is added because it is something I would play.

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
There are reasons for this.

Here, you have Nexus.
Nexus is a gamemode that never quite reached the height of popularity that Nebula once had. You could play the same thing with a Nebula TDM gamemode which was more balanced and where you could build, versus a gamemode that could become more stale and had less balancing/features to it. Nexus, regardless of map updates or kit updates to keep it fresh, never peaked much. If my mind serves me correctly, it was actually at one point the least played gamemode. It's how the gamemode is made and intended to be played. It just simply doesn't get on the level that a player wants, so it's not played often because you can play a better version on Nebula.

Here, you have Control the Hill.
It has indeed had bugged knockback, fast hitting, and broken explosives, however previously it started dying off anyway in which case made it less of a priority for development. The kits and map updates didn't revive it at the time it was declining before the bugs, and even adding older maps to the rotation and making forum post calls for more maps and contests, it still had declined interest. If we fixed it in the state its in, I doubt people would play it again regardless. This is why we can look forward to a new, improved version integrated with Nebula, King of the Hill.
